title: Rename billingUrl to billingEndpoint in shared-contracts and consumers (platform-kit has no references)

summary: Renamed billingUrl to billingEndpoint (same value) in libs/shared-contracts and its 3 consumers (core-shell, sub-route-billing, sub-route-reports) via PR #1; CI and CD green. Assumptions: shared-contracts is inlined at build time, so no version bump needed; platform-kit has no billingUrl references (checked by grep), so it was left untouched.
